description: This walk takes you from Bangor to Groomsport in County Down. The route runs for a distance of about 6.5km (4 miles), passing along the coastal path between the two settlements. The route starts off in Bangor where you can enjoy a stroll along the lovely Ballyholme Beach. You'll then head east to Kingsland and Groomsport where there is a picturesque harbour and fine views over Belfast Lough and the north coast of the Ards Peninsula. You can continue your walking in the area by heading west to visit Crawfordsburn Country Park .
